# Timia

> Online booking platform for salons, nail studios, spas, and beauty businesses in New Zealand — an alternative to Timely, Fresha and Booksy.

Timia lets salon owners take online bookings, payments, and loyalty rewards without the hassle of complicated software. It is built and supported in New Zealand, with a free plan to start and no credit card required.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.timia.nz/): Overview of Timia's booking, payments, and loyalty features for NZ salons.
- [Features](https://www.timia.nz/features): Full feature list — online booking, staff scheduling, point of sale, loyalty, reporting.
- [Pricing](https://www.timia.nz/pricing): Plans and pricing, including the free forever plan.
- [Explore salons](https://www.timia.nz/explore): Directory of salons using Timia, bookable online.
- [Timia vs Timely](https://www.timia.nz/compare/timely): Honest feature and price comparison with Timely for NZ salons.
- [Sign up](https://www.timia.nz/register): Create a free Timia account.
- [About](https://www.timia.nz/about): Why Timia was built and its values.
- [Contact](https://www.timia.nz/contact): Support and sales contact.

## Blog
